title: Authorization proof pack and deployment gate criteria for private deployments
creator: Nora Patel
description:
Context: As we onboard enterprise customers to Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem), customers require a concise, verifiable bundle of security evidence before a production cutover. This ticket defines an 'Authorization Proof Pack' (APP) — a machine- and human-readable bundle that documents SSO/SAML configuration, RBAC role mappings, audit log export/retention, KMS/HSM key policies and rotation proof, and operational runbooks — plus the deployment gate criteria and signoff workflow required by Sales, Security, and Ops.

Goals: Provide a minimally sufficient, repeatable proof pack and gate that: (1) reduces back-and-forth during customer onboarding; (2) creates deterministic acceptance criteria for internal and customer signoff; (3) automates evidence collection where possible; (4) prevents risky rollouts by gating production enablement until checks pass.

Scope: Private deployments (VPC and on-prem) only. Hosted API and Dedicated pools excluded. The APP covers authentication & authorization (SSO/SAML, OIDC, RBAC), key management (KMS/HSM policies, rotation history), auditability (log export, integrity checks, retention), and operational readiness (runbooks, incident playbooks, rollback plan). This ticket results in a PRD appendix and an acceptance checklist that must be handed to sales/CS and used by Solutions + Security to certify deployments.
acceptance_criteria: SSO: SAML metadata uploaded and validated against the customer's IdP; example SAML assertion captured and successfully validated in staging; SAML SP certificate chain present and within validity period.

RBAC: Role matrix uploaded (CSV) mapping customer roles to Redwood platform roles; automated least-privilege lint run with no high-severity violations; test account demonstrates enforced deny rules for out-of-scope actions.

KMS/HSM: Customer key policy documented and attached; key material located in KMS or HSM with documented ARN/identifier; rotation proof: at least one successful rotation captured with audit trail entries within the retention window.

Audit logs: Audit export pipeline configured to customer's target (S3/Blob/SIEM); sample export (last 7 days) available; integrity verification (checksum) present and retention policy >= requested SLA (default 365 days or per-customer agreement).
Operational runbooks: On-call runbook for auth failures and key compromise created and validated; playbooks include rollback steps, telemetry dashboards, and runbook owner assigned.
Automated checks: Evidence pack generation script runs without errors and produces an APP artifact (signed manifest + artifacts bundle) stored in the deployment workspace.
Signoffs: Required stakeholders (Solutions Eng, Security, Infra Ops, Legal for regulated customers) have recorded explicit approval entries in the APP manifest prior to production cutover.
signoff_checklist: Solutions Engineering: APP artifact reviewed and validated with customer; acceptance test (SSO login + token introspection) performed in the customer's staging environment.
Security Engineering: RBAC matrix and KMS/HSM policy reviewed; no critical risks outstanding; formal risk acceptance or mitigation plan documented.
Infra/Ops: Audit export and retention validated; runbooks tested via tabletop exercise; rollback plan reachable within SLA window.
Legal/Compliance: Data residency and retention terms validated for regulated customers; evidence of legal review attached (if applicable).
Customer Success: Customer signoff captured (explicit email or signed manifest entry) confirming that their SSO, RBAC, and KMS expectations are met.
PM: Confirms APP artifact uploaded to customer onboarding workspace and that the deployment gate is satisfied before flip to production.
Release Engineering: Confirms automated APP generation integrated into the deployment pipeline and gating flag is set to 'enabled' for the release stream.
risks: Incomplete evidence: customers receive APP but artifacts are insufficient for audit — mitigated by mandatory pre-cutover checklist and automated linting.
False positives from automated RBAC lint: may block go-live unnecessarily — mitigated by triage SLAs and a documented exception flow.
KMS/HSM integration variance across customer environments (cloud KMS vs. on-prem HSM) — mitigated by supported templates and a compatibility matrix included in APP.
Operational burden: manual review steps may create onboarding delays — mitigated by automating capture for the most common checks and providing an exceptions UI for edge cases.
qa_plan: End-to-end onboarding test using a staging IdP: validate SAML assertion chain, SP metadata, and login flow.
RBAC enforcement tests: create a test principal for each mapped role and execute a cross-section of allowed/denied API calls to confirm behavior.
KMS rotation replay: run rotation script in staging and validate audit trail entries and APP inclusion.
Audit export validation: configure export to test S3 bucket and verify integrity checks and retention lifecycle policy enforcement.
Tabletop exercise: simulate key compromise and run rollback/mitigation playbook with Ops and Security observers.
